metric: average concurrent server-side SDK connections across the calendar month
note: Observations are real readings from LaunchDarkly plan usage, not projections. Cost per container is derived from them, because an analytical estimate was wrong by roughly three hundred times: short-lived clients reconnecting every five minutes were assumed to cost 0.005 concurrent each and actually cost about 1.2. Never replace an observation with a calculation.
